The matcher needs the unbroken phrase.

Change, in knowledge.yaml only, item k_sl_3b_a_r1: append these entries to the SECOND (object) group of action_evidence, after the last existing entry, as plain unquoted items in the same style: water and air alarm, water and air alarms, false water and air alarm, false water and air alarms, air alarm, air alarms, water alarm, water alarms. Do NOT touch the verb group. Do NOT add 'inspect', 'examine', 'check' or 'read' anywhere (that would make 'Examine the inspection console' fire the reveal).
